verdict.rationale: Token2 ships desktop, mobile, CLI and browser tools for managing FIDO2, PIV and OTP security keys, and software like this could plausibly include an in-app assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions a built-in AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one. The documented features are manual key management, a bulk-enrollment script and a tray watcher, none of which is an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
